and cyclically permutes the other two.Every lattice isometry has a linear part in the square’s dihedral group. Modulo the rotor’s quarter-turn symmetry, every complete rotor image therefore belongs to one of the two translation families  $R_+$  or  $R_-$ .More explicitly, write
$$R_s(a,b)=\{(r+a,sc+b):(r,c)\text{ is a reference role}\},
\qquad s\in\{1,-1\}.$$
If  $z$  is an endpoint with reference role  $e\in E$ , its parameters are forced:
$$(a,b)=(z_r-e_r,\ z_c-se_c).$$

C_{\rm other}
